verdict.rationale: Any product with a public web presence could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies even though Instinct is itself an agent. The probes found only a permissive robots.txt and a sitemap listing just the homepage, with no docs site or developer pages, and nothing shows an llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. Allowing AI crawlers in robots.txt is an adjacent control and earns no credit toward this story.
